sn55.25:2.10: Sarakāni sakko sikkhāya aparipūrakārī ahosī ti || ||
sn55.25:4.1: Idha Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:5.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:5.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussāṇam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.25:5.6: so pañcannam orambhāgiyānam parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti || upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti || sasaṅkhārapavirinibbāyī hoti || asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī || ||
sn55.25:5.7: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā || pe || parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 9.
sn55.25:6.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:6.5: na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.25:6.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokam āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti ||
sn55.25:6.7: ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā || pe || parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 10.
sn55.25:7.1: Idha pana Mahānama ekacco puggalo Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:7.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā ti || pe ||
sn55.25:7.5: na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.25:7.6: so tiṇṇam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā sotapanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ||
sn55.25:7.7: ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā || pe || parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 11.
sn55.25:8.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe na heva kho Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:8.8: ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo agantā nirayaṃ-apāyaduggativinipātaṃ || || 12.
sn55.25:9.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo na heva kho Buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno ||
sn55.25:10.1: Seyyathāpi Mahānāma dukkhettaṃ dubbhūmi avihatakhānukam bījāni cassu khaṇḍāni pūtini vātātapahatām asārāni asukhasayitāni || devo ca na sammādhāram anupaveccheyya || ||
sn55.25:10.2: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyyum tī || ||
sn55.25:10.4: Evam eva kho Mahānama idha dhammo dvākkhāto hoti duppavedito anīyāniko anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedito ||
sn55.25:10.6: tasmiṃ ca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī
sn55.25:11.1: Seyyathāpi Mahānāma sukhettaṃ subhūmi suvihatakhāṇukaṃ bījāni cassu akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sārāni sukhasahitāni ||
sn55.25:11.3: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyyun ti || ||
sn55.25:11.5: Evam eva kho Mahānāma idha dhammo svākkhāto hoti supavedito nīyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhapavedito
sn55.25:11.7: tasmiṃ ca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī
sn55.25:11.10: Mahānāma sakko maraṇakāle sikkhāya paripūrakarī ahosī ti || || 1.
